people.imagined: Dawn on the flooded terraces before the planting. She has walked out to the edge of the top terrace in her wet green rite robe, knee-deep in mud, and has turned her head into her sleeve to cough before anyone sees. She comes up smiling anyway.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a flooded rice terrace at dawn, she has just turned her face into her sleeve to hide a cough and now lifts it with a bright smile. Face: a small brown face, round and creased by smiling; deep laugh lines at the eyes and mouth; warm dark brown eyes, shining and a little tired; soft thin brows; a small nose with a sunburnt tip; a wide smiling mouth with a pale tint at the lips; a faint grey hollow under each cheekbone. Hair: grey-black, drawn into a low knot held by a green jade pin, a light rice-straw hat on a silk cord tipped back behind her head like a halo. Body: small, narrow-shouldered and slightly bent, standing ankle-deep in the water. Clothing: the richest rain-grey and leaf-green silk of the abbey, three layers with crossed collars embroidered with falling rain and rice ears in silver thread, a pale grey gauze over-robe beaded like dew whose wide sleeves float and trail in the water, a sash of woven green silk with a green jade drop and long tassels, the hem darkened by the flood. Hands and objects: the left sleeve is raised near her mouth; the right hand holds a long banner pole whose undyed silk banner hangs behind her, painted with small round signs of the seasons, no writing. Power: a soft green and watery-blue aura, a few drops of rain hanging in the air around her sleeves. Background: stepped terraces of flooded water catching a pink sky, mist among bamboo. Light: soft pink-gold dawn spirit-light from the upper left, a gentle glow on the water and a rim light along her cheek. Expression: a bright, kindly, creased smile with warm tired eyes, a woman hiding her pain behind her welcome.

people.imagined: The gate of the abbey at midday, with the posted price board behind him. He sits on a stool counting beads quickly with one hand while chatting pleasantly, as he always does with a buyer.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a small table at the abbey gate, flicking the beads of an abacus with one hand while smiling warmly at a buyer just out of frame. Face: a plump round clean-shaven face, soft double chin; fair smooth skin; round cheeks pink and shiny; small bright intelligent eyes, lively and shrewd under neat brows; a short soft nose; a small pleasant mouth with a generous smile; a shaved head. Body: plump, round-shouldered and comfortable, short arms. Clothing: a fine robe of rain-grey silk, spotless and pressed, over a pale green under-robe, two crossed collars embroidered with tiny rain and rice ears in silver; wide sleeves with a pale gauze over-sleeve beaded like dew, one sleeve with the end of a small abacus showing; a broad sash of deep green silk with a green jade drop. Hands and objects: the right hand rests on a wooden abacus on the table, fingers poised on the beads; the left hand is raised in a welcoming gesture, palm up, soft and unmarked by work. A round bronze seal with twenty-four small marks lies by his elbow. Power: a faint green-brown shimmer, like damp mist, settles over the table and his sleeves. Background: the abbey gate in blurred bamboo and an empty wooden board hung on a post, blank, drifting mist. Light: warm pearly spirit-light from the upper left, a soft gloss on his bald head and a gentle rim light. Expression: friendly, reasonable, quietly calculating.

people.imagined: Terrace at harvest. He is on one knee in his good boots holding up a spirit-rice head to the light, counting the grains with his thumb. He is thinking of the sacks that will run out by autumn and smiling anyway.
people.subject: The moment: crouched at the edge of a golden terrace, holding up a single heavy head of rice against the sky and smiling at it. Face: a tall man's long sunburnt face with a strong chin; skin warm brown and creased at the eyes; thick even brows; calm brown eyes; a straight nose; a wide kind mouth with a closed smile; a short neat beard with a few threads of grey; a faint worry line between the brows. Hair: black, tied in a neat top-knot with a green cord and a small jade pin, no hat. Body: tall, broad-shouldered, long-limbed, crouched on one knee. Clothing: a rain-grey silk robe kilted at the knee for the terrace, with green-embroidered rice ears along the borders of two crossed collars, a pale gauze over-sleeve beaded like dew, a green silk sash with a jade drop; under it good pale silk trousers; and on his feet a pair of fine tall black boots, a landlord's boots, polished and the most surprising thing in the lower frame. A strip of green silk round the right wrist. Hands and objects: the left hand, large and coarse with farmer's calluses, is spread on his knee; the right holds a rice head, heavy with pale gold-green grain that glows. Power: a soft green-gold aura rises from the grain and drifts around his hand in a few motes. Background: golden stepped terraces falling away to a misty plain, a small stone granary. Light: warm harvest spirit-light from the upper left, a gentle rim light on his beard. Expression: gentle, proud, quietly worried.

people.imagined: A dry night in the Thu Trì market, with the first drops of the rain she has just called starting on the lamp-lit stones. She stands in her black rain cloak with a wine cup, looking up at a window above the stalls she would like to rent.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a night market in her black rain cloak, a small wine cup in one hand, looking up past the viewer at an upper window while the first drops fall on her hood. Face: a long pale face, high cheekbones and a narrow chin; skin cool and fine; sharp dark brows with an arch; large dark eyes, a little tired and amused, heavy-lidded; a long straight nose; a wry mouth with one corner lifted, lips stained with wine; a tiny rain-drop at the end of the nose. Hair: black and glossy, loose over one shoulder and wet, the rest under a deep hood of black silk, a silver rain-drop pin at the temple. Body: tall, long-limbed, easy slouch, one hip cocked. Clothing: a long hooded rain cloak of fine black waxed silk, glistening wet, thrown open over a rain-grey and green silk robe of the abbey with two crossed collars embroidered with falling rain in silver, a pale grey gauze over-robe beaded with dew; a sash with a green jade drop. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a small white wine cup with a thin rim; the left pushes back the hood edge; at her wrist a thin cord of green jade beads. Power: faint blue-green water mist curls round her fingers and the rain bends toward her. Background: blurred paper lanterns in red and gold, wet dark stalls, silver threads of fine rain against the lights. Light: warm lantern glow from the upper right with a cool blue moon-like rim from the left. Expression: lazy, sly, wanting something out of reach.

people.imagined: In the herb gardens at dusk. A visitor has offered a hand and she has taken it in both of hers and lifted it to her nose, eyes closed, quietly reading it. She has not said a word yet.
people.subject: The moment: in a herb garden at dusk, she is holding a stranger's outstretched hand in both of hers, bending to sniff it with her eyes closed. Face: a gentle, plain, rounded face; skin tan and a little weathered; lashes lowered on the cheeks; soft brows; a small broad nose slightly wrinkled and drawn forward in the act of sniffing, the main thing; a soft closed mouth; a small leaf-shaped scar on the chin. Hair: brown, neatly braided and coiled low at the nape with a green jade pin, a sprig of green mint behind the ear. Body: slender, a little stooped. Clothing: soft rain-grey and pale green silk, a crossed collar embroidered with tiny herb leaves, wide sleeves tied back with green ribbons, a pale gauze over-robe beaded like dew, a green silk sash with a small gourd and a jade drop hanging from it, a few herb sprigs tucked in the sash. Hands and objects: her two hands cup a stranger's hand, brown and pale, in the middle of the frame, her thumb on the wrist; dried herbs poke from her sash. Power: a faint green wood-qi glow around her hands and a few leaf-shaped motes turning on the air. Background: neat beds of herbs under a low sky, hanging bunches drying on a rope, soft purple mist. Light: soft violet dusk spirit-light from the upper left, a gentle rim light on her cheek. Expression: absorbed, kind, reading what she smells.

people.imagined: In the grove after a storm. He has just cut a struck pole and stands with the saw in his right hand and the left hand held up, the missing ring finger toward the viewer. A plume of green cane smoke curls from a small fire beside him.
people.subject: The moment: in a bamboo grove after a storm, holding up his left hand with the missing ring finger, a drawn-out smile of satisfaction on his face. Face: a lean, dark, shrewd face, cheeks hollow; skin brown with smoke stains; narrow eyes that slide sideways; thin, slanted brows; a long nose; a thin lip curling; a small gap in the grin; one tooth in front is chipped. Hair: black, tied up under a wrapped green silk cloth, a few damp strands stuck to the forehead. Body: lean, long-armed and wiry, coiled like a spring, standing on his toes. Clothing: a rain-grey silk robe kilted to the knee, with a crossed collar embroidered with rice ears, one sleeve darkened and singed by smoke, silver-grey gauze half burnt at its edge; dark bracers of green silk cord; a sash with a small green jade drop; sandals of bamboo fibre. Hands and objects: the left hand is held up at the shoulder, fingers spread, the ring finger missing at the knuckle, plainly visible; the right hand holds a small curved saw with a pale handle and a fresh green pole with a scorched black band. Power: tiny green-white sparks crawl along the scorched cane and jump to his fingers. Background: a bamboo grove after a storm, tall lightning-scarred bamboo, black split canes on the wet ground, a curl of green smoke, a few white flashes in the clouds beyond. Light: pale dusky spirit-light from the upper left with a green flicker along the cane. Expression: a slow, sly, satisfied smile, pleased with himself and giving nothing away.

people.imagined: Evening on the terraces. He is walking back with a shin bandaged for the third time this month, looking at the empty far hill where the Bell Tower stands. He squints toward it and smiles at nothing.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a terrace in the evening, squinting into the bright distance toward a tower out of frame, a white bandage on his shin. Face: a sun-reddened, open, boyish face; eyes narrowed to slits as if still staring at something bright; wide cheekbones, a snub nose; thin brows pushed together by the squint; a gentle half smile; a small bruise on the left cheekbone. Hair: dark and untidy, tied with a green silk cord, a few stalks of straw stuck in. Body: tall, thin and slightly clumsy, long-armed, weight on his good leg. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of the abbey, a rain-grey robe with a plain crossed collar and a thin green embroidered border of rice ears, kilted to the knee, wide sleeves; a light rice-straw hat hanging on his back by a silk cord; the right shin wrapped in a thick white bandage, the main mark. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a long bamboo pole slung on his shoulder; the left lifts to shade the eyes. Background: flooded terraces reflecting a low sun in long bands of gold, a single distant tower on a hill, a bamboo fence and a pair of white egrets in the water, soft mist. Light: low gold spirit-light in his face from the upper left, a thin rim light on his hair. Expression: a dazzled, patient, open look, the eyes narrowed against the glare and the mouth in a gentle half smile, a boy who does not mind being made to wait.

people.imagined: At the planting dance, her mouth wide open in a loud laugh, the gap of two missing back teeth showing, one hand on another girl's shoulder in a way that is a little too heavy.
people.subject: The moment: laughing loudly at a planting festival, her mouth wide open and the gap of two missing back teeth on one side showing, one hand pressed hard down on a girl's shoulder at the frame's edge. Face: a broad, bright, ruddy face; round cheeks, dimpled; wide dark eyes, very bright and a little hard; strong black brows; a snub nose; the open laughing mouth with the visible gap at the back left, drawn large; a glint of cruelty under the fun. Hair: black, in two thick pigtails tied with scarlet silk cord, one flung forward. Body: strong, broad-shouldered and stocky, a farm girl, leaning toward the shoulder under her hand. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of the abbey, a rain-grey robe with a crossed collar and a green border of rice ears, sleeves pushed up; a bright red silk belt and a string of dried red seeds round the neck. Hands and objects: the right hand lifted in a drumming gesture; the left presses on another girl's shoulder, only partly visible at the edge, the knuckles whitening. Power: a few bright green motes dance round her laughing mouth. Background: green seedlings in shining water, a line of singers in grey silk, blurred, a flag of coloured silk on a pole, a pale warm sky over the hills, drifting mist. Light: bright, cheerful spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim light on her cheeks. Expression: a loud, joyous, wide-open laugh with the bright eyes a little hard.

people.imagined: A river bank at sunrise. He is in the middle of explaining his plan for the new isle and has lost the sentence, staring at the horizon where the mud isle shows, his rope-scarred hand lifted and pointing.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a river bank at sunrise, one hand pointing out across the water, eyes drifting to a far horizon mid-sentence. Face: a long, eager, tanned face; bright dark eyes set far away; strong brows lifted; a prominent nose; a mouth half open on a word he has forgotten. Hair: black, in a short tail tied with a green silk cord, a river reed behind the ear. Body: tall, lean, and restless, leaning forward, wind flattening the robe against his thin frame. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of the abbey, a rain-grey robe with a pale crossed collar and a faint green wave border, kilted to the knee with a green cord, sleeves pushed back above rope-scarred forearms; a light straw hat hangs on his back by a silk cord; a water gourd at his hip; bare feet caked with river mud. Hands and objects: both hands show a row of pale, thick rope scars across the knuckles; the right points; the left grips a coil of rope hung from his shoulder. Background: a wide shining river with rising mist, a low dark isle of wet silt crowned with reeds and a few birds in the distance, a hired boat drawn up on the shingle. Light: bright golden sunrise spirit-light from the upper left over the water, a soft rim light on his profile. Expression: a dreamy, hungry, far-off look, the lips a little parted, as if listening to a call only he can hear.

people.imagined: Night on a Thu Trì street. She carries a heavy pack of rain-caller's poles on her shoulders and follows a black-cloaked woman through the market, unhappy, her eyes scanning the lamps.
people.subject: The moment: walking through a night market with a heavy bundle of long poles on her shoulders, scowling a little at the lamps. Face: a broad, honest tan face with a clear pale sunburn line across the nose that has never faded, a straight stripe; steady grey-brown eyes, cautious; strong straight brows; a wide mouth turned down; sturdy chin. Hair: brown, plaited and wound round the head, a grey silk band across the forehead. Body: broad-shouldered and strong from a ferry pole, solid and upright, shoulders almost as wide as her hips. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of the abbey, a rain-grey robe with a plain crossed collar and a thin blue wave border, tied up at the hip with a faded blue ferry-rope belt, sleeves rolled above forearms ropy from the pole; silk straps cross the chest holding the load; a light straw hat dangles at her back; wet boots. Hands and objects: both hands steady a bundle of pale bamboo poles tied with cord across her shoulders; broad, callused palms. Power: a faint blue-green river mist clings to her shoulders. Background: a lantern-lit lane crowded with stalls selling dyed silk, steaming bowls and paper charms, a black-cloaked woman's shape moving ahead through the crowd, rain-slick cobbles reflecting the lamps in red and gold streaks. Light: warm lantern glow from the upper right with a cool blue rim. Expression: a wary scowl at the lamps, the wide mouth turned down and the eyes steady and watchful, patient with the load and unhappy with the place.

people.imagined: Mid-morning on the terraces. He sits on a dyke with a bamboo shoot in his fist and an easy grin, one trouser leg rolled up higher than the other, while someone else's row is being weeded beside him.
people.subject: The moment: sitting lazily on a terrace dyke with a fresh bamboo shoot in his hand, grinning broadly. Face: a round, easy, sunburnt face; heavy-lidded merry eyes; sleepy brows; a flat wide nose; a big loose grin; a small cut on the chin. Hair: messy brown, a light straw hat pushed back on his head, a few bamboo-sheath hairs caught on the sleeves. Body: soft, round-shouldered and relaxed, sprawled with one knee up and the other leg straight, leaning back on his left elbow, the round face turned up to the sun; feet bare and muddy. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of the abbey, a rain-grey robe with a pale crossed collar and a faint green border, the wide sleeves covered with pale gold bamboo-sheath fuzz; one trouser leg rolled to the knee, the other down to the ankle. Hands and objects: the right hand holds up a pale conical bamboo shoot with brown scales; the left holds a leaf-wrapped rice ball; a woven basket half-full of shoots sits by his hip. Power: none, only a faint green glow on the shoot. Background: terrace steps falling away in bands of flooded green, a bent figure weeding blurred in the lower right, bamboo groves on the crest, a thin plume of smoke from the abbey kitchen, soft morning mist. Light: warm mid-morning spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim light on his hair. Expression: a big, loose, sleepy grin with the heavy lids half down, a boy perfectly content to let the day go by.

people.imagined: A remembered portrait of the founder as she first called rain on the bamboo hill, her arms raised to a pale sky, a sea-coast woman among the farmers.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the founder at fifty, arms raised, calling rain on a bare bamboo hill in drought. Face: a lean weathered coastal face, high cheekbones, brown from sea-spray; deep calm lines; dark intense eyes looking up; strong straight brows; a narrow nose; a firm mouth slightly open in a chant. Hair: black streaked with grey, hanging loose and windblown, a string of white shells and a silver pin at the temple. Body: tall, spare and straight, standing on a rock with her back arched and arms flung wide. Clothing: a flowing sea-blue and rain-grey silk rite robe, fine and layered, two crossed collars with a pale wave border, long wide sleeves falling from her raised arms like water, a sash of woven grey silk cord with a pale jade drop and long tassels; bare feet on the stone. Hands and objects: both arms raised, the palms open to the sky; a long silk banner painted with small round season signs, no writing, hangs from a pole behind her. Power: a strong sea-blue aura, a spiral of fine drops and mist rising from her palms toward one distant dark cloud. Background: a pale dry sky, a bare bamboo hill, cracked paddy earth below and small figures of farmers kneeling in rows, their faces turned up. Light: pale spirit-light from the upper left, the cloud edged with silver. Expression: a fervent, steady, generous look with the dark eyes lifted to the cloud and the mouth open in a chant. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened.

people.imagined: A remembered portrait of the grain keeper in the dry winter of 1186, at the grove, holding the rite pole upright with all his strength, mist weak above him.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of a grain keeper of fifty-five holding a rite pole upright with both hands in the dry winter, his face lifted to a pale sky, drawn with effort. Face: a thin, honest face, pale and lined; thick grey brows drawn together; eyes of mild brown lifted upward, steady; a narrow nose; a firm, slightly open mouth; a short grey beard, neat; sweat at the temple. Hair: grey, pinned neatly in a small topknot with a bamboo pin. Body: thin, upright, shoulders braced. Clothing: a plain, clean rain-grey silk robe with a crossed collar and a thin green border, a pale green silk sash knotted flat with a second thin cord at the wrist; sleeves pulled back to the elbow; a small bone abacus bead hangs from his belt like a pendant. Hands and objects: two thin hands grip a tall pale bamboo pole, knuckles white and shaking slightly, tendons standing in the wrists; a few strips of green silk tied at its top. Power: a thin pale-green thread of qi runs up the pole toward a small cloud that will not grow. Background: the winter grove a dense wall of black-green bamboo with a few frost-white stalks, the ground bare and cracked, a small pale cloud hanging above the tallest canes, two quiet figures kneeling at the edge with bowls held up. Light: cold grey-silver spirit-light from the upper left. Expression: a devout, strained look held calm, the eyes fixed upward and the mouth steady, a stiff stillness over a deep worry. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened.

people.imagined: At the rite ground, in the hush before the abbess begins. She stands holding the pole upright with her hands calloused, lips moving in a whispered count of breaths, her eyes on her mistress.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a rite ground holding a tall pole, whispering a count of breaths, eyes fixed on someone just out of frame. Face: a calm, pale, oval face; steady grey-brown eyes, full of watchful kindness; level brows; a small straight nose; lips moving mid-count; a few fine lines at the eyes. Hair: fine black, smoothed back and knotted low with a green jade pin, a loose lock resting at her cheek. Body: medium height, composed, upright and quiet, a stillness that makes her seem taller; her thumb marks a count against the pole and her breath makes a faint pale cloud. Clothing: a refined rain-grey silk robe over pale green, two crossed collars embroidered with falling rain, narrow cuffs turned back twice, a pale gauze over-sleeve beaded with dew, a green silk sash with a small jade drop; a small paper packet of pills peeks from her sleeve. Hands and objects: both palms held open toward the viewer near the pole, each crossed by two thick horizontal calluses, drawn plainly. Power: a calm pale-green glow along the pole and a few drops of mist circling her wrists. Background: at the far side of the circle, out of focus, the abbess's small figure in a green robe stands with arms lifted; the rite ground is ringed with a dozen pale poles each topped with a green ribbon, the earth swept smooth, bamboo hills dissolving in morning haze. Light: soft pale spirit-light from the upper left, a gentle rim light. Expression: an attentive, tender look, the lips moving through the count and the eyes warm with watchful kindness.

people.imagined: In the grove at noon, hearing someone laugh about bells. He has gone red and has put his hand to the raw birthmark on his neck while his other fist rests on a barrel lid.
people.subject: The moment: in a grove at noon, rubbing a raw red bell-shaped birthmark on his neck with one hand while the other fist rests on a barrel lid, glaring. Face: a square, hard, sunburnt face; heavy dark brows pulled down; fierce dark eyes; a wide jaw clenched, the muscle showing below the ear; a short thick nose; the birthmark on the left side of the neck, shaped like a small bell, thumb-print sized, red and raw, the thing the eye finds first. Hair: black, cropped short and rough. Body: thick-necked, strong, broad-shouldered, a hard stance, shoulders hunched. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of the abbey, a rain-grey robe with the collar open to show the birthmark, a thin green border, sleeves pushed to the elbow, a green silk sash; a small hatchet hangs from his belt. Hands and objects: the left hand is clamped to the side of his neck; the right fist, knuckles split and scabbed, rests half-open on a round wooden barrel lid, dark cracks running out from the fist across the wood. Power: a faint metallic-white shimmer on the knuckles and a few pale motes. Background: an open yard of cut bamboo piles with the bark peeling, a rain barrel with its lid missing, a broken pole on the ground, two blurred novices at the edge pretending not to look; a thin line of mist and light cuts through the grove. Light: hard cold spirit-light from the upper left with a thin white rim. Expression: a simmering, set-jawed scowl, the brows low and nostrils tight, anger held down behind a hand pressed to the red mark.

people.imagined: At a night market stall as a buyer approaches. She has slid her left hand with its blue-dyed middle finger into her sleeve while her face turns to a smile of welcome.
people.subject: The moment: smiling a smooth welcome at a buyer at a night stall while tucking her left hand away into her sleeve. Face: a sharp pretty oval face with a pointed chin; clever dark eyes with long lashes, bright; thin neat arched brows; a small straight nose; a practised smile, lips tinted plum; a tiny beauty mark at the left corner of her mouth. Hair: black, in a high smooth knot held by a silver pin shaped like a raindrop. Body: slim and graceful, quick, her skin faintly flushed in the lantern light. Clothing: a fine, close-fitted rain-grey silk robe with a light blue under-collar at the throat and two crossed collars embroidered with raindrops in silver, a sash of blue-grey silk with a small silver raindrop clasp and tassels; the right sleeve cut wide and draping, a pale gauze beaded like dew over it, the left gathered close to hide the stained finger. Hands and objects: the left hand half hidden in the sleeve, the middle finger deeply stained bright blue, visible; the right holds a small bamboo tally stick. Power: a faint blue water haze drifts round her sleeve. Background: the stall behind her hung with indigo-dyed silk in bolts of every shade of blue, a lantern of blue paper, a basin of water with a floating leaf, a buyer's broad back at the edge, wet cobbles shining under the lamplight. Light: warm lantern glow from the upper right with a cool blue rim light. Expression: a practised, charming smile with the long-lashed eyes bright and level, a welcome with a price behind it.

people.imagined: In the herb beds at night with a lantern. He counts jars aloud, stammering, and then laughs a half beat late at nothing, quite sure someone is stealing.
people.subject: The moment: crouched at night in a herb bed with a lantern, counting sealed jars aloud, mouth caught on a hard sound. Face: a round, mild, earnest face; wide pale eyes looking slightly puzzled; thin faint brows; a soft nose; a mouth stuck half open on a stammer, a soft laugh coming too late; soil smudged on the cheek. Hair: brown and short, soil in it. Body: soft-shouldered and heavy-handed, crouched. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of the abbey, a rain-grey robe with a pale crossed collar, the knees muddied, a green silk sash stained with sap, sleeves rolled unevenly; a tiny brown moth rests on his shoulder. Hands and objects: both hands hold a small clay jar sealed with wax the way a child would hold a baby bird, plump, steady and clumsy, every nail rimmed black with soil; a row of four more jars in front of him. Power: none, only a faint green glow in the jar-wax. Background: neat dark herb beds beneath a low moon, a bamboo fence with a lantern on a post, a basket of cut herbs, the sealed jars lined in the grass with their wax caps shining; a distant thin man in a monk's cap seems to watch from the path through the mist. Light: small orange lantern glow from the lower right with cool moonlight above. Expression: an earnest, slow, suspicious frown, the lips caught half-shaped on a hard sound and the eyes darting to the dark beyond the lantern.

people.imagined: At the edge of the planting field, wet hair from the paddy water, she opens her mouth to sing and only shapes the words, her chipped tooth showing.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the edge of a planting field with wet hair, mouth open to sing but making no sound, her chipped front tooth showing. Face: a thin brown face, open and bright; dark wide eyes with a flicker of fear; arched brows; a small nose; an open mouth with one front tooth chipped diagonally, visible; wet cheeks. Hair: black hair soaked and clinging to her neck, a drip falling from a strand, a single green ribbon half undone. Body: slight, shoulders narrow, throat pulled in, collarbones sharp. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of the abbey, a rain-grey robe kilted to the calf over wet silk trousers, dark with water at the shoulders and back, a thin green border; a pale green silk belt half undone and hanging. Hands and objects: one hand pressed lightly to her throat; the other pinches a bundle of seedlings tight; a wet braid drips onto the robe in a spreading stain. Power: none; a faint blue-green mist at her feet. Background: on the field's far side a crowd of singers in grey silk stand in a long line with their mouths wide open, a drum on a stand, a bright flag of coloured silk, rows of green seedlings in the water reflecting a pale sky, a taller girl turning away. Light: clear, bright spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim light on her wet hair. Expression: a wide, yearning, frightened look with the lips parted to sing and no sound coming, the dark eyes flickering with fear.

people.imagined: Before a storm in the grove. He stands barefoot with a bundle of cut poles on his shoulder, looking at the darkening sky, a streak of white in his hair standing out as the first thunder sounds.
people.subject: The moment: standing barefoot in a bamboo grove under a darkening sky, a bundle of cut poles on his shoulder, looking up at the first flash. Face: a lean, open, brown face; clear trusting eyes tipped up; level brows; a straight nose; a calm half-open mouth. Hair: black with a distinct streak of lightning-white at the left temple, large and plain; tied in a short tail with a green silk cord. Body: wiry and lean, long-armed, steady, feet apart on the dark earth, the old white scars plain across both soles and ankles. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of the abbey, a rain-grey robe kilted high to the knee with a thin green border, a green cord belt and a short saw at the hip; bare feet. Hands and objects: the right hand steadies a bundle of pale bamboo poles on the shoulder, each as long as two men and pale as bone with a scorched black band near the top; the left holds a small curved saw. Power: white-gold sparks gather at the tips of the poles and in his white lock of hair. Background: a thicket of tall black-green bamboo bent in a rising wind, leaves flying, the ground strewn with split canes, a white lightning thread forking behind the clouds, a thin figure farther in, the master, standing quite still among the stalks. Light: eerie grey-green storm spirit-light from the upper left. Expression: a calm, expectant, trusting look with the eyes tipped up and the mouth half open, unafraid of the flash.
